{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Calculate mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Final check: confirm no QA orders or refunded orders are included
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']

print(f"QA orders included: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(f"Refunded orders included: {len(refunded)}")
print(f"Loyal completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
